body:

# The Al's Amazing Advancements is one of many future and planning Al's mods. 
As of 9/2/2025, I can only create neoforge files. I will soon get a plugin for Mcreator so I can make a fabric version. Either that or i just make it both neo and fabric.

## :::DISCLAIMER:::
### I am new to modding.
I just picked up the idea of modding recently, so the quality will NOT be perfect. but PLEASE at LEASSSSTTTT enjoy it :D




This mod adds several new advancements for the game. They are mostly for niche purposes like collecting turtle shells or making smooth stone.
Here are the advancments:
- Lookin Smooth
- Just like my grandpapy taught me
- Another man's trash is another man's treasure
- Buttload
- Utterly Cute with some Scutes
- Back to the original

(There are more, but i forgot them since mcreator was in 2025.2 at the time of making those.)
